rationale: Haibo and Udit both work at the intersection of robotics and computer vision, with complementary strengths: Haibo is advancing robot manipulation through equivariant deep learning and data-efficient imitation learning (published at CoRL, RAL, IJRR), while Udit brings production systems experience and hands-on robotics perception work including depth estimation and hand-eye calibration. Their combined expertise in geometric deep learning, perception systems, and structured learning could inform practical implementations of Haibo's research or help bridge his hierarchical skill-learning insights into deployed robotics applications.
intro_message: Haibo Zhao, meet Udit Karthik — you're both deep in robotics and computer vision from different angles (research vs. production), and your work on data efficiency and perception systems could complement each other well.
